text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: —No matter. Seeing you squirm in frustration was entertaining enough.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: "Do not forget. You are one who strives to stand beside the King."

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"Do your very best.
...Now, show me some entertainment."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It ended in a disappointing result...
